## Source inspected
The PDF was read. It is a finding aid, not the ECPM manual it cites.
:::

## Annotation

The entry that matters for this archive reads, in full as inspected:

> BC Rehab & Greater Vancouver Home Support Society  
> “Enhanced Consumer Participation Model: Skill Development Manual for Consumers of Home Support Services”, BC Rehab & Greater Vancouver Home Support Society, 1990  
> A training manual that includes 5 modules intended to empower consumers to act as effective employers (52 pages plus appendices)

A nearby BCCPD 1997 conference-proceedings entry mentions “the Choices in Support for Independent Living Program” (wording as in that annotation). That is a later conference report, not a 1993–95 ministry file.

This page confirms that a 1990 ECPM manual was known to individualized-funding bibliographers by the late 1990s. It does not prove the manual’s contents.

## Open questions

- Original publication date and edition of the bibliography itself.
- Whether the compiler inspected the 1990 manual or copied another list.
